question: What great attainment becomes dear to the yoginīs through this practice?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation form a combined attainment
This attainment is described as a great accomplishment
Such accomplishment can become dear to the yoginīs
inference: The practice yields a great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation, becoming dear to the yoginīs.
